description: This file defines the ShoppingCart class, which models a shopping cart in an e-commerce system. It includes data structures and methods for managing shopping cart items, item groups, promotions, user session details, and other shopping cart-related attributes.

classes.name: ShoppingCart
classes.description: Represents a shopping cart in an e-commerce system, providing methods to add, remove, find, and manipulate shopping cart items and related attributes.

classes.name: ShoppingCartItem
classes.description: Represents a single item within the ShoppingCart, including product details, quantity, price, and custom features.

classes.name: ShoppingCartItemGroup
classes.description: Represents a grouping of shopping cart items, which can be nested hierarchically.

classes.name: CartShipInfo
classes.description: Contains shipping information for a specific shipping group within the cart.

classes.name: CartPaymentInfo
classes.description: Contains payment information for the cart.

classes.name: ProductPromoUseInfo
classes.description: Tracks promotional codes and usage information related to cart promotions.

methods.name: addOrIncreaseItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the cart or increases its quantity if it already exists, handling complex product features and attributes.

methods.name: addNonProductItem
methods.description: Adds a non-product item, such as service or fee, to the shopping cart.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a specific ShoppingCartItem object to the cart at a specified index.

methods.name: findCartItem
methods.description: Finds a cart item by product ID, features, attributes, and selected amount.

methods.name: findAllCartItems
methods.description: Retrieves all cart items with a specific product ID, optionally filtered by group number.

methods.name: removeCartItem
methods.description: Removes a cart item identified either by object or index from the cart.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the cart.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Returns a list of all items currently in the cart.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the cart items.

methods.name: getItemGroupByNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an item group based on its group number.

methods.name: addItemGroup
methods.description: Creates and adds a new item group to the cart and returns its group number.

methods.name: deleteItemGroup
methods.description: Deletes an item group and disassociates cart items from it.

methods.name: setUserLogin
methods.description: Associates a user login with the cart and triggers recalculations and promotions.

methods.name: handleNewUser
methods.description: Handles logic when a new user logs in, including recalculating prices and promotions.
